source: Code review of app(3).zip; applies to API_ENABLED=false baseline

items.limitation: FakeAuthRepository starts with no accounts. Register and perform simulated verification in the current process; account and email-action tokens are in memory.
Profile reads AppUser from AuthSessionProvider. Email cannot be changed. Settings reminder toggle persists locally but OS notification scheduling is not implemented.
Dashboard uses MockAnalyticsRepository sample metrics. Marked demo; not tied to actual fixture completion.

VocabularyProvider._catalog has six words while topic summaries display totals 20 and 24. Quick Quiz requires five unique words studied today and is gated by daily goal; set goal to 5 for offline fixture exercise.
ReviewSelectWordsProvider local mock uses a distinct nine-word data set and IDs v1-v9; it is separate from VocabularyProvider IDs t1-v1..t2-v3.
Vocabulary audioUrl fields are empty and playAudio is TODO; do not assert successful audio playback.
Grammar catalog contains eight local lessons. Progress is stored in SharedPreferences per user.

Question bank contains 200 deterministic local questions, but mock attempt/draft/result state is held in memory; restart persistence, Backend acknowledgement, server idempotency and ownership are not proven.
Source media URLs/content are missing or not backed by actual audio/image assets. The question descriptions/transcripts are not a substitute for real media playback.
MockAnalyticsRepository returns demo metrics (predicted 685 etc.), not user-derived records.
Local canned replies only; conversation history and quota are in memory; Backend integration safety gate is false.
API-dependent behaviors must remain Blocked/Not Tested offline, even if a local UI scenario passes.
